hypothesis: The pinned EXL3 converter can capture matched real BF16-flow and recipe-quant-flow activations, Hessians, and correctly decoded BF16 weight slices for an actual Qwen layer without using the invalidated uniform toy quantizer.
falsifier: Missing target/Hessian/activations, converter-to-safetensors BF16 mismatch, source identity drift, non-finite rows, mismatched slice identities, or failed owner-service restoration falsifies the capture harness.

controls.bf16_flow: skip quantization before target while propagating real calibration states through BF16 modules
controls.quant_flow: apply the exact hydrated K5/K5/K6 and attention-K6 recipe before target
controls.weight_decode: compare every converter slice exactly against safetensors BF16 decoding

decision_rules.accept: Both captures pass all identities, contain 256 finite real activation rows, positive Hessian counts, four exact BF16-decoded 128x128 slices, and the maintenance transaction restores the owner service.
decision_rules.reject: Any capture, identity, BF16 decode, finite-value, slice, or rollback invariant fails.
decision_rules.promotion: Control capture only. No mathematical method or candidate may be promoted from this experiment.
